implemented_requirements.requirement: Computer selects a hidden sequence of colors (or digits)
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.MastermindGame.__init__ generates a secret via palette.random_secret or accepts a provided secret. colors.ColorPalette.random_secret creates a random list of symbols.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player attempts to guess within a set number of tries
implemented_requirements.evidence: Main loop in main.play_round uses MastermindGame.max_attempts and tracks attempts via game.attempts_used / attempts_remaining. UI prompts until game.is_over.

implemented_requirements.requirement: After each guess, show feedback regarding correct color and correct position
implemented_requirements.evidence: ui.ConsoleUI.show_feedback renders exact and partial peg counts; ui.show_board displays feedback for all previous guesses.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Distinguish between exact matches and partial color matches
implemented_requirements.evidence: feedback.evaluate_guess returns Feedback with exact_matches and partial_matches; UI renders PEG_EXACT (●) for exact and PEG_PARTIAL (○) for partial.
ui.ConsoleUI.show_outcome prints a win message when game.is_won, a lose message when attempts exhausted, and a give‑up message.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Input handling for color symbols and full names
implemented_requirements.evidence: colors.ColorPalette.normalize parses single‑letter strings, comma/space separated tokens, and full names; returns a list of symbols.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Configurable difficulty (code length, attempts, palette size)
implemented_requirements.evidence: config.DIFFICULTIES defines presets; main.choose_difficulty lets the player select; palette is sliced to the requested size.

critical_issues: None observed that prevent core functionality. The only minor concern is reliance on ANSI escape codes, which may not display correctly on some Windows consoles without enabling VT processing.
judge.summary: The provided source files implement a complete, functional Mastermind game: secret generation, guess validation, exact/partial feedback, win/lose reporting, and a console UI with difficulty selection. All core requirements are satisfied, and the code appears ready to run as a standalone script. Minor cosmetic issues (ANSI compatibility) do not affect core correctness.
